scope: One read-only pg_stat_activity snapshot of the owned test database backend. Host PID mapped through NSpid to PostgreSQL container namespace; initial host-PID lookup returned no row and was not treated as termination. Only command classification/liveness metadata exported, not SQL body/parameters/content. Revision UPDATE is fixture preparation outside GET timers. Additional metadata connection closed; no data/configuration/source mutation. This snapshot is not query execution CPU, request SQL timing or a causal explanation of preparation duration.
not_measured: Cause of long UPDATE; JIT time; query CPU; rows_returned/affected/scanned; locks over time; causal monitor overhead; request latency/validation/backend capacity
